figures.caption: CD spectra of PA-13 in aqueous solution (blue), 30 mM SDS micelles (red), 50% TFE (green) and 0.05% LPS (orange). Circular dichroism spectra were measured at 25 °C using a Jasco-815 spectropolarimeter. The samples were loaded in a rectangular quartz cell (0.1 cm path length), and the spectra were recorded at a scanning speed of 10 nm/min in the wavelength range of 190 to 260 nm.
